anchor: Plan v29 Phase 1.2 — Country Economic Profile (CEP). 50 Tier A countries (top 30 by GDP + 20 strategic emerging markets) hand-anchored. Tier B/C inherit from regional clusters until later phases populate them. Every field is internal — never named in user-visible copy (R-002).
convention: All monetary fields in USD (2024 reference year). Percentages stored as decimals where pct sits in the field name (vat_gst_standard_pct = 0.20 means 20%). employer_social_pct etc. stored as decimals. Quality flags A/B/C/D track the research depth of each field.
